boot_line: The forest is quiet. The Manatree is waiting.
tooltip_wood: Soft timber from the Harvest Tree.
tooltip_stone: Cool river-rock, still dusted with moss.
tooltip_food: Berries from the bush — good to Offer.
tooltip_essence: Grows with every careful watering — and with the Fruit.
node_wood_cancel: You step away from the Harvest Tree.
harvest_busy_other: Finish this first — or walk away.
tree_examine_generic: The Manatree. Heart of the last living fragment.
tree_water_start: You water the Manatree. Magic gathers.
tree_water_ancient_note: Ancient — still drinking, still giving. The Fruit waits when you are ready.
tree_water_ancient_block: Ancient — still drinking, still giving. The Fruit waits when you are ready.
tree_offer_ok_wood: You offer Wood. The Manatree settles stronger.
tree_offer_ok_stone: You offer Stone. Roots find purchase.
tree_offer_ok_food: You offer Food. Care made visible.
tree_offer_ok_manashards: You offer a Manashard. Magic threads into the bark.

ascend_toast: A new cycle. The Sapling greets you.

welcome_boot: The forest is quiet. Tend the Manatree.

welcome_hint: Click the Manatree to water. Harvest Tree, Stone, and Berries fill your hands.
tree_next_stage_growth_ready: Growth ready — bring what it needs
pause_new_game_confirm: Begin again as Keeper? This clearing’s progress will be lost unless you saved.
pause_options_soon: Options will open later. For now, the forest waits quietly.
pause_exit_confirm: Leave the clearing? Unsaved care may fade with the light.
pause_slot_overwrite_confirm: Overwrite this memory? The older cycle will be gone.
pause_load_empty: Nothing grows in that slot yet.
